objective: deliverResult in scripts/runner/report-result.mjs only retries HTTP 5xx; a dropped connection throws immediately and loses the task result. Retry recognised transient transport failures (connection reset/refused, timeouts, DNS flakes, including AggregateError of them) up to three attempts with a short doubling wait, resending the identical body. Redirect refusals and other configuration errors stay terminal and must not leak error details. scripts/runner/report-result.test.mjs must pass.
